_header:
Three finders in parallel (faithfulness, verdicts, coverage; all general-purpose, no Codex agent type available), dispatched 15:24:30Z; all three returned by ~15:28Z.
Raw counts: faithfulness 5 (3 Important, 2 Nit), verdicts 9 (9 Important), coverage 6 (4 Important, 2 Nit) = 20.
Duplicates merged: faithfulness F1 = verdicts F8 (R1-01); faithfulness F2 = coverage F4 (R1-02).
Count line (merged): 18 findings: 15 Important, 3 Nit.
Routing (4.4): to the verifier (Important): R1-01 to R1-15. Straight to fix (Nit): R1-16, R1-17, R1-18.
Verifier: 11 Real, 4 Not real, 0 Style only. Dropped: R1-07, R1-09, R1-14, R1-15 (4/15). Kept: 11 Important + 3 Nit = 14.
Status: fixed 13 (R1-02, R1-03, R1-04, R1-05, R1-06, R1-08, R1-10, R1-11, R1-12, R1-13, R1-16, R1-17, R1-18); answered 0; open 1 (R1-01); Pre-existing 0 (not an update run).
Each finding below is the first source finder's text verbatim, renumbered R1-nn; the verifier line is verbatim.

R1-01.decision: Kept, Important. Verifier: Real (partial point on G-03 noted; core not refuted).
R1-01.status: open. The inputs only add the outcome name OrderNotCancelled (tool confirmation change 2) and give no handling for it after CO-A2 returned cancelled; which report and which handoff reason (refund not issued, or cancellation unknown after a lookup) is a business choice only the user can make. CO-A3 failure row and CO-S17 row 3 left unchanged.

R1-02.status: fixed. Failure row now requires a lookup after the second unanswered CO-A2 and branches on it; CO-S15 requires that lookup (Forbidden + trajectory); new CO-S25 (cancelled), CO-S26 (shipped), CO-S27 (still open) cover the new branches.

R1-03.status: fixed. Branch now says 'the refund is not confirmed yet'; CO-S20 uses new dimension 'Refund not confirmed reported'.

R1-04.status: fixed. New rule CO-09 [minimal guarantee]; new dimension 'Cancellation and refund reported' asserts it in 9 success scenarios.

R1-05.status: fixed. New rule CO-10 [success guarantee] (added rather than changing CO-08's text); asserted by 'Cancellation and refund reported'.

R1-06.status: fixed. CO-S03 row 4: a yes and an order change in the same turn.

R1-07.decision: Dropped. Refutation: SG-01 'a repeated refund call for an order returns the same refund id' and Appendix A 'every later call returns that same refund'. I read both: if the first, unanswered CO-A3 had created the refund, the second call would return it, so a second ProviderUnavailable means no refund exists and 'has not been issued' is true without a lookup. I agree it refutes the finding.

R1-08.status: fixed. CO-S19, CO-S20, CO-S21: the refund is created by the second unanswered CO-A3, the first creates none.

R1-09.decision: Dropped. Refutation: CO-S11 Unambiguity note 'The status change is tied to the agent's first cancellation ... in row 2 the agent learns the order shipped only from a lookup after the unanswered cancellation'. I read it with the Final state 'HG-10482 has status shipped': the scenario fixes that the lookup after the timeout shows shipped, so no second CO-A2 is called for. I agree.

R1-10.status: fixed. CO-S03, CO-S04 Turn 2 anchored on the confirmation question for HG-10482, defined by an (optional) (before Turn 2) confirmation-form pair.

R1-11.status: fixed. Dimension wording accepts both 'cannot be cancelled' and 'was not cancelled'.

R1-12.status: fixed. Dimension says stating the total paid in the proposal counts.

R1-13.decision: Kept, Important. Verifier: Real (partly refuted for CO-S07/CO-S08, which no verdict turns on; the CO-S10 instance stands). Kept for the CO-S10 instance.
R1-13.status: fixed. 'Orders unavailable reported' defines 'proposes no cancellation'. CO-S07/CO-S08 instances left (no verdict depends on them).

R1-14.decision: Dropped. Refutation: G-04 is an 'only when' condition, and CO-06 'It makes a second CO-A2 only after the first went unanswered and a lookup made after it shows the order still placed or processing' adds a requirement; G-04's clause cites SG-01 only. I read G-04, CO-06 and SG-04: a necessary condition grants no permission, so the two rules do not conflict and CO-S13 asserts the stricter one. I agree.

R1-15.decision: Dropped. Refutation: §5.2 'A rubric judge reads every text the agent sends, including text sent alongside a tool call' with the CO-S23 dimension 'never says ... that staff will follow up'. I read both: they decide the finding's trajectory the same way under either reading of 'once', so no verdict is ambiguous. I agree.

R1-16.status: fixed. Removed failure_reason from Appendix A.

R1-18.status: fixed. CO-S01 row 4 (no order number, one open order); CO-S09 row 4 (different amount).
